title: Jamaican Ham Wrap
description: A unique twist on traditional wraps, this Jamaican ham wrap combines the flavors of the Caribbean with the ease of a Thai-inspired meal.
instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
2. Cook the sliced cucumber until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
3. In the same pan, add the Jamaican curry sauce and stir until heated through.
4. Add the shredded cheese and stir until melted.
5. Add the cooked cucumber to the cheese mixture and stir until combined.
6. Warm the crispy wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
7. Assemble the wrap by placing the cooked cheese and cucumber mixture on one half of the wrap.
8. Add the sliced ham on top of the cheese mixture.
9. Sprinkle fresh cilantro over the top.
10. Fold the wrap in half to enclose the filling.
